title: 妮蔻 · 叶尖蝴蝶
description: 妮蔻蹲在大叶子旁看蝴蝶，彩色尾巴卷成柔软的问号。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Neeko retains her bright green chameleon-like skin, expressive large eyes, colorful pink-purple hair, fin-like ears, and long curling tail. Dress her in a fully covering cheerful leaf-patterned tunic and short leggings, with recognizable turquoise and coral accents. Retain this champion's distinctive silhouette and recognizable accessories, softened into friendly rounded shapes with opaque clothing wherever appropriate.
art_direction.scene: She crouches beside an oversized garden leaf and holds one hand still while a small butterfly settles on her finger. The tail curls separately behind her, and a few chunky crayon flowers frame the quiet sunny corner. Keep the composition spacious and peaceful, with visible wax-crayon strokes, warm paper margins, and every important prop clearly separated.
art_direction.palette: leaf green, turquoise, coral, lilac, warm cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
